import bpy,json,collections,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Vector
root=Path(bpy.data.filepath).parent.parent;cap=root/'captures/shipyard_ground_20261115';craft=bpy.data.collections['Shipyard_COMBINED_Craft'];bank=bpy.data.objects['M14 continuous sculpted shore bank']
checks=[]
def ck(name,value):
 assert value,name
 checks.append(name)
ck('ground pass saved',bool(craft.get('ground15_bank')))
ck('steel final saved',bool(craft.get('ground15_steel_revision')))
ck('broad working flags',sum(o.name.startswith('M14 working flag') for o in craft.objects)==16)
ck('three shore steps',sum(o.name.startswith('M14 shore stair') for o in craft.objects)==3)
ck('no bank faces in open basin',all(not(abs(p.center.x)<4.48 and p.center.y<2.65) for p in bank.data.polygons))
inlet=[v.co.z for v in bank.data.vertices if 4.48<v.co.x<6.14 and -1.30<v.co.y<.48]
ck('stair inlet below lowest tread',max(inlet)<1.026)
mats=collections.Counter(o.data.materials[0].name for o in craft.objects if o.type=='MESH' and o.data.materials)
ck('roof and monitor count',mats['M15_RoofWeatheredSteel']==90)
ck('wall elevation count',mats['M15_WeatheredWallElevations']==59)
ck('retained original roof UV',all(o.data.uv_layers.get('UV_PreGround15') for o in craft.objects if o.name.startswith('Steel roof panel')))
ck('retained original wall UV',all(o.data.uv_layers.get('UV_PreM15Elevations') for o in craft.objects if o.type=='MESH' and o.data.materials and o.data.materials[0].name=='M15_WeatheredWallElevations'))
samples=[{'xy':[x,y],'height':bpy.app.driver_namespace['ground15']['sample'](x,y)[0]} for x,y in [(4.48,-.4),(4.88,-.4),(5.51,-.4),(6.16,-.4),(5.4,-3)]]
data={'checks':checks,'bank_vertices':len(bank.data.vertices),'bank_triangles':len(bank.data.polygons),'inlet_max_height':max(inlet),'samples':samples,'editable_objects':len(craft.objects)}
(cap/'source_final_audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
print('SOURCE_AUDIT',len(checks),'passed',data['inlet_max_height'])
